preflight.warning_banner: CLOSE ALL BACKGROUND APPS BEFORE STARTING!
preflight.warning_body:
For accurate, repeatable AnTuTu-grade scores across OS versions:
1. Close all background apps, downloads, and suspended games first.
   (OS API does not allow killing third-party apps automatically.)
2. This suite switches to FULLSCREEN and LOCKS input until finished (~95s).
3. Do not press HOME or sleep the console until testing completes.

comment.title: Automated Hardware & Bottleneck Analysis
comment.grade_splus: Tier S+ Ultra: Exceptional frame pacing and compute headroom across every subsystem.
comment.grade_s: Tier S Flagship: High sustained throughput across 600K+ 3D geometry and multi-core workloads.
comment.grade_a: Tier A Balanced: Solid overall console performance with consistent frametimes.
comment.grade_b: Tier B Baseline: Functional profile; heavy shadows and multi-light passes limit 3D ceiling.
comment.gpu_bound: Bottleneck Note: Workload is primarily GPU fragment/geometry-bound during 602K PBR + shadow passes.
comment.cpu_bound: Bottleneck Note: Single-core & worker scheduling constrain draw/physics submission before GPU saturation.
comment.balanced: Bottleneck Note: Well-balanced CPU-to-GPU pipeline with proportional scaling between compute and 3D.
comment.scaling_good: Multi-Core Scaling: Excellent parallel speedup ({0}x across {1} worker threads).
comment.scaling_low: Multi-Core Scaling: Moderate thread contention ({0}x across {1} worker threads); close background tasks.
comment.io_fast: Storage Health: Fast sequential & 4K I/O response; minimal save stutter risk.
comment.io_slow: Storage Health: Slow storage throughput detected; heavy asset streaming may stutter.
comment.pacing_smooth: Frame Pacing: Tight 1% low stability; negligible thermal throttling or GC spikes.
comment.pacing_var: Frame Pacing: Noticeable 1% low frametime dips; verify thermal headroom & background tasks.
